[comment by BlayTheNinth (member)]
This is expected, Mojang made a lot of internal changes between 1.20.4, 1.20.6 and 1.21. Modded worlds generally cannot be migrated fully between those versions.

[comment by Smalldero (none)]
I created a little tool that converted my 1.20.1 savegame to be compatible with 1.21 waystones. All my waystones are still working after the conversion. So if anyone wants to try to get their waystones working again you can check out my little [conversion tool](https://github.com/Smalldero/waystones-1.21-converter). How to use it is described there. But make sure to use a savegame where the waystones were still working, otherwise it sadly wont work. And you dont need the whole savegame, just the `waystones.dat` file. So it is possible to mix your current savegame with an older `waystones.dat` that you converted with this tool if you dont care about losing the new waystones you created since the old working version.
